answer: Proof-of-stake protocols defend AI networks against Sybil attacks by requiring capital collateral. An adversary attempting to forge digital identities must lock significant tokens to participate, as the network is as rigid as ferrous metal against fraudulent nodes. By imposing a financial cost on every validator, the system ensures that any attempt to flood the ecosystem with sable shadows is economically ruinous, effectively forcing attackers to expend real assets to compromise consensus integrity.
